subject: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access — next steps
content:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access — next steps

Hi Sam — great to speak earlier. Thanks for the demo time and for walking through NimbleHealth's intake priorities. Per our call I wanted to summarize the ask so your security/audit team has a concise handoff: 

1) Documents we need to evaluate (priority order):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) + control matrix
   - Bridge letter or interim attestation if report is older than 12 months
   - Completed vendor DDQ (I've attached our DDQ v1.2 for convenience)

2) Access:
   - Read-only access to your trust portal (or an S3/Share link) where artifacts are stored.
   - If a portal is not available, a secure share (Link + account) that allows our compliance reviewers to download logs and evidence.

3) Scope/questions we flagged in discovery:
   - Data residency: confirmation that patient PII subject to HIPAA remains within US regions (or explicit list of regions).
   - Encryption in transit & at rest and KMS usage for customer data.
   - GDPR: whether NimbleHealth processes EU personal data on Redwood-hosted customers or if controller agreements are required.

Timeline/request: if you can provision portal access (read-only) and either the SOC2 Type II PDF or bridge letter by EOD Wednesday (2027-07-28), that would keep our procurement timeline on track for an August go/no-go. 

Attached: Redwood_DDQ_v1.2.pdf (short vendor questionnaire) and a SOC2_Request_Template.docx with fields we typically ask teams to complete.

Next steps: can you confirm who we should add on your side (security@nimblehealth.com or a named reviewer) and preferred secure-transfer method? I’ll loop Ben from SE for any technical evidence requests.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

---

From: Sam Park <sam.park@nimblehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@nimblehealth.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the DDQ. I looped our security inbox (security@nimblehealth.com) and our compliance lead, Teresa Lin, will shepherd this. A few quick notes: 

- We have the most recent SOC 2 Type II (period ending 2027-03-31).
- We can generate a bridge letter if the auditor approves — that usually takes 48 hours to sign off after internal review.
- For portal access: we use an internal TrustVault portal (read-only links). We prefer to grant time-limited accounts rather than broad S3 links.

Can you set the minimum list of artifacts you need up front (e.g., SOC report PDF, control matrix, Kryptek KMS config, retention policy doc, and one example of access logs)? That helps Teresa scope the handoff.

Also — HIPAA & GDPR: we classify customer data as PHI where applicable and currently store primary customer data in us-central1 and us-west1. I’ll include the data-residency statement in the next message.

Sam
Sam Park
Head of IT Security | NimbleHealth
sam.park@nimblehealth.com

On Tue, Jul 26, 2027 at 15:10 Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see above)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@nimblehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access — next steps

Sam — quick note from SE side: when you provision portal access, the access pattern we need is:

- Read-only account scoped to a folder called /audits/redwood-inference (time-limited 30 days)
- Download permission for PDF/CSV artifacts only (no admin actions)
- If possible, include an example of the Keystore/KMS policy export (redacted keys OK) and an export of last 90 days of access logs for a single subsystem (auth service).

If portal account creation requires an IP allow-list, we can provide our audit IPs or we can fetch artifacts over a secure signed link (prefers the portal UX though).

Happy to jump on a short call with Teresa to detail the artifact exports so they’re packaged cleanly for auditors.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

---

From: Sam Park <sam.park@nimblehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 17:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access — next steps

Marissa/Ben — Teresa confirmed the SOC2 PDF is available and she can provision a time-limited read-only account in the TrustVault portal. Planned timeline:

- Wed 2027-07-28 by 20:00 UTC: TrustVault account created for marissa.cole@redwood.ai and ben.carter@redwood.ai (30 days, download allowed).
- Thu 2027-07-29 by 23:59 UTC: SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) uploaded and control matrix linked in portal.
- Fri 2027-07-30: Bridge letter available if requested (auditor sign-off required).

Data residency confirmation: primary customer data resides in us-central1 and us-west1; we do process EU data for a small subset of customers under standard contractual clauses — Teresa will attach the controller/processor note in the portal.

One ask from our side: please confirm the minimum artifact set you need (Marissa, Ben) so Teresa can prioritize the upload order. If you need the DDQ pre-filled, I can share a contact for our procurement team to coordinate responses.

Thanks —
Sam
